video_title: Zion Williamson on late game execution, 3PT shots | Pelicans vs Pacers Postgame Interview 10/21/26

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the team's failure to execute down the stretch
quotes.excerpt: down the line we didn't execute the turnovers throughout the game caught up to us
quotes.quote: Overall thoughts on the game is we gave ourselves a chance to win. Down the line we didn't execute the turnovers throughout the game caught up to us. Their transition points as well, I want to say they had 25, 27 transition points. And then late in the game we just got to execute. We got to get the shots we want, just like they got the shots they want. We just got to get the shots we want, at least get the shot off and just can't turn over.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the Pelicans loss to the Pacers: We gave ourselves a chance to win but late in the game we just got to execute. We got to get the shots we want and just can't turn over.

structured.context: Zion Williamson discusses the team's loss to the Pacers and their failure to execute in the final minutes of the game.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the team's trust in his shooting ability
quotes.excerpt: those guys even Coach Mo, they trust me. We've been putting in a lot of work
quotes.quote: It was a good feeling though. Like I spoke on Sham and RG earlier, those guys even Coach Mo, they trust me. We've been putting in a lot of work. They trust me to shoot it and even on I think one of the first ones I passed up, they was like don't do that again. Like shoot it. And you know it means a lot, especially seeing your work pay off. Individually that's cool, but I really wanted to start off with a dub.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson says his teammates and coaches are encouraging him to shoot more: They trust me to shoot it and even on one of the first ones I passed up they was like don't do that again. Like shoot it.

structured.context: Zion Williamson discusses his teammates and coaches encouraging him to shoot more three-pointers during the game.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on overcoming the hurdle of winning in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: it's hard to win in this league, so if we want to win, that's a hurdle we just got to get over
quotes.quote: I feel like we are right there, like we're going to make that turn, but it's tough saying it when respectfully I feel like we've dealt with that the past two, three years. And I've said it before, it's hard to win in this league, so if we want to win, that's a hurdle we just got to get over.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the Pelicans struggling to close out games: It is hard to win in this league so if we want to win that is a hurdle we just got to get over.

structured.context: Zion Williamson reflects on the difficulty of winning in the NBA and the team's struggle to overcome late-game hurdles.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on Jeremiah Robinson-Earl's competitive spirit
quotes.excerpt: he's a competitor who just wants to win, so I'm glad he's with us
quotes.quote: He's going to stand his ground and I told him, I said as long as I'm out there with you, you good man. Do whatever, get in people's head, talk whatever it is, I'm going to be right there with you like I'm going to protect you. So you know that's just the energy he brings to the game and not just to the game, that's just who he is as a person. Like he's a competitor who just wants to win, so I'm glad he's with us.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson praises Jeremiah Robinson-Earl for his competitive spirit: He is a competitor who just wants to win so I am glad he is with us.

structured.context: Zion Williamson praises the competitive spirit and energy that Jeremiah Robinson-Earl brings to the team.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the need to close games to see results
quotes.excerpt: if we want to start seeing numbers in the win column, we got to close games
quotes.quote: We've adapted to it, I would say fairly quick. But the reality of it is it's hard to win in this league and if we want to start seeing numbers in the win column, we got to close games. We got to close games and it's not just those last two, three minutes, it's the turnovers before that, the empty possessions and we can't have too many empty possessions against a team like that who they get up and down pretty fast.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the Pelicans needing to improve late game execution: If we want to start seeing numbers in the win column we got to close games.

structured.context: Zion Williamson explains that the team must improve their late-game execution and reduce turnovers to start winning games.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the team's flexible 'who's night is it' mindset
quotes.excerpt: the mindset we have is more of you know kind of who's night is it
quotes.quote: Based off the conversations we've had as a team, I think it's more the mindset we have is more of you know kind of who's night is it. Because we got a lot of guys who can go get it and we just kind of are going to go off that until we find something that works. I think when we find something that works, we'll stick with it.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the Pelicans offensive mindset: We got a lot of guys who can go get it and we just kind of are going to go off that until we find something that works.

structured.context: Zion Williamson describes the team's offensive philosophy of identifying who has the hot hand during the game.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on Yves Missi's development and physicality
quotes.excerpt: he's a dog, like he's not going to back down from nobody, he's going to bring the smoke
quotes.quote: Yves Missi has played hard his whole career. He's in the gym, works on his craft and I mean he's a dog, like he's not going to back down from nobody, he's going to bring the smoke to be honest. So you know to see the physicality, to see him battling on the boards, battling defensively, going up for like blocked shots and then just getting up the court is great. You know his minutes have gone up, his condition is where it needs to be and you know he's put the work in, long story short.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on Yves Missi: He is a dog like he is not going to back down from nobody he is going to bring the smoke.

structured.context: Zion Williamson discusses the development, physicality, and work ethic of teammate Yves Missi.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the New Orleans crowd's energy
quotes.excerpt: when there's something to cheer about, you going to feel the crowd
quotes.quote: The crowd's always there. Even if it was half that crowd, when there's something to cheer about, you going to feel the crowd. And I say that all the time about the Smoothie King Center and really it's the New Orleans culture. Like if you give them something to cheer about, hundred fans, thousands of fans, it's going to get loud.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the New Orleans crowd: If you give them something to cheer about hundred fans thousands of fans it is going to get loud.

structured.context: Zion Williamson comments on the energy and support provided by the New Orleans crowd at the Smoothie King Center.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the maturity required for physical play
quotes.excerpt: now it's just the maturity of time and place, knowing when to do it and when not to
quotes.quote: I like the physicality we brought. I think now it's just the maturity of time and place, knowing when to do it and when not to, kind of seeing how the refs are calling it. Some quarters they'll let you play, other quarters they may not as much. So it's just the maturity of knowing when you can be physical.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on the team's physical play: I like the physicality we brought. I think now it is just the maturity of time and place knowing when to do it and when not to.

structured.context: Zion Williamson discusses the need for the team to show maturity regarding when to play physically based on officiating.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on Tyrese Haliburton's recovery from injury
quotes.excerpt: I know it's not a walk in the park, so you know for him I'm glad he was able to recover
quotes.quote: You know that was a tough injury he experienced and I kind of was able to see it up close with Dejounte, so I know it's not a walk in the park. So you know for him I'm glad he was able to recover from something like that and you know return healthy to the court.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on Tyrese Haliburton returning from injury: That was a tough injury he experienced and I am glad he was able to recover from something like that and return healthy to the court.

structured.context: Zion Williamson expresses his support for Tyrese Haliburton returning to the court after recovering from a significant injury.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on Siddiq Bey's impact off the bench
quotes.excerpt: great player, great player for us on this team
quotes.quote: Great player, great player for us on this team. You know whatever is asked of him, he's going to do it, he's going to make it happen. And you know when you bring a guy like that off the bench, it can go so many different ways, but it's always going to be productive.
quotes.social_post: Zion Williamson on Saddiq Bey: When you bring a guy like that off the bench it can go so many different ways but it is always going to be productive.

structured.context: Zion Williamson praises Saddiq Bey for his productivity and willingness to fulfill any role coming off the bench.
